entities.name: Radvaň, Banská Bystrica
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Radvaň is a borough of Banská Bystrica, located south-west of the city centre. Until 1964 it was a separate village, when it was merged into the village of Radvaň-Kráľová, which in turn was made part of Banská Bystrica in 1966.
